objective: Gate the reductions (monotone circuits and not-all-equal propagation as knot patterns, every piece checked by knotlab) and measure native rounds, untangling phases and rank on random and structured atom patterns against frozen predictions.
status: Supported 2026-11-16 (referee pending): frozen run of 386 cases (150 random atom patterns n = 2^10..2^20, 220 random circuits, structured families), all gates held; 9 of 13 predictions held (P1, P2, P2a, P3, P3b, P4, P6, P7, P8) and 4 failed (P2b n^(1/4) at fixed alpha*: slope 0.32; P5 one phase carries the leap: 0 of 8; P6-linear: growth d^0.41; P9 loose fringe: ratio 1.8). At the jump rounds ~ n^0.30 (312 at 2^20), phases 0.57 per doubling (12 at 2^20).
title: Atom patterns: the known wall, native rounds and untangling phases measured
